title: Scheduled Maintenance: Database Upgrade
summary: We're performing planned maintenance to upgrade our database version and improve reliability. The maintenance will take place within a 30-minute maintenance window, and Langdock is expected to be unavailable for approximately 15 minutes. We've reserved the additional time to allow sufficient time for the upgrade and verification. We've scheduled this during off-peak hours to minimize disruption. Thank you for your patience! The Langdock Team
